name: phantom2-remotion
description: Phantom 2.0 — Remotion graphics compositions (reel overlays + post stills). Rendered programmatically by backend/lib/edit/remotion.js when REMOTION_ENABLED=1; lives outside backend/ so none of this toolchain enters the backend npm tree or the Fly image (Docker context is backend/).

scripts.render:endcard: remotion render src/index.ts EndCard out/endcard.mov --codec prores --prores-profile 4444 --image-format png --pixel-format yuva444p10le
